result.decision_rationale:
The focused gate passed, and the fresh-Horse construction fix is supported. Four defects still block saved-horse repair. An observer-only guarded run can consume the player's claim, a native exception can produce a false Applied result, a verified no-op loses its retry, and a replacement claim can receive another request's archive suffix.

## Continuation for Claude

Round 2 exhausts PR-4's two-round allocation. Preserve this result for the owner's decision. If further work is authorized, keep the correction within the repair service and its focused tests. Recognize the observer-only guarded launch, classify the actual feature collection after every attempted removal, and bind archival to the bytes that received the decision. Preserve the fresh-Horse filter, native combat authority, request-free observer control and existing safety guards.

The next review needs offline cases using the observer's actual launch arguments, a native removal that changes a neighboring fact and then throws, a removal that returns without changing anything, and a claim replaced during publication. Bind the focused Fast gate to the corrected candidate. N07 and N10 remain owner playtest observations.

findings.actual: CompositionRoot uses runtimeAutomation != null to identify a guarded run. Invoke-KingmakerRuntimeScenario.ps1:1226 launches this control with only -kmcObserverRequest arguments, so CreateFromCommandLine returns null. The observer redirects SaveManager and area paths, while KMC's UserDataParent resolves to the player's ApplicationPaths.persistentDataPath. Once the fixture party loads, the repair poll can overwrite the player's result and rename the stranded claim to .interrupted.
findings.blocking_rationale: A disposable control can consume a player's repair record and change a protected profile surface.
findings.expected: A guarded process accesses repair files only through a proven run-owned folder. Without that binding, it skips claim recovery.
findings.requested_correction: Recognize the observer-only guarded launch when selecting the repair folder. Suppress the poll there unless the service has a verified run-owned folder. Preserve the control's request-free KMC startup.
findings.requested_evidence: Exercise the production launch classification with the observer-only arguments and a null KMC host. Seed the player folder with a claim and result, then verify identical filenames and bytes after polling. Retain the ordinary-play and KMC-isolated controls.
findings.title: The request-free guarded control still opens the player's repair folder
findings.trigger: The repository runs chunk7-normal-player-control while the player's KMC user-data folder contains a stranded .claimed file.

findings.actual: TripRepairFileHost.Remove checks the feature delta only after RemoveFact returns. If RemoveFact changes the target and a neighbor and then throws, that check is skipped. A failure while enumerating the post-removal candidates also skips it. The policy catches the ordinary exception, sees the target absent in StillPresent and publishes Applied. The test host injects FailRemovalAfter only after its delta check has succeeded.
findings.blocking_rationale: The result can tell the owner that exactly the requested fact was removed after another fact was lost. If the target survives a partial change, presence alone can also release the claim for another attempt.
findings.expected: Applied requires verification that only the requested instance disappeared. Retry requires verified absence of change. An inconsistent or unreadable outcome is terminal.
findings.requested_correction: Capture the relevant feature identities before calling native removal and classify the collection on both return and exception. Preserve an unverified or inconsistent outcome through reporting retries. Count an application only after exact removal is established.
findings.requested_evidence: Inject a native-boundary callback that removes the target and a neighbor and then throws before the adapter's checks. Verify a terminal failure, no Applied result and no second removal after reload. Keep the positive control where only the target disappeared before the exception.
findings.title: A native removal exception can still be recorded as an exact success
findings.trigger: RemoveFact throws after changing the collection, or a post-removal check throws before the adapter verifies the delta.

findings.actual: TryReadClaim hashes the bytes and closes the read handle. Publish subsequently calls Close with only the suffix. Close moves whatever occupies ClaimPath at line 421. If the claim for horse A is replaced with bytes for horse B during the result write, those bytes can be archived as .applied even though only A's fact was removed.
findings.blocking_rationale: The archive can attribute removal to the wrong request and consume the replacement. This breaks the required link between the owner's bytes, the horse and the disposition.
findings.expected: The bytes committed to a terminal archive are the bytes bound to that decision. A replacement receives its own conservative disposition.
findings.requested_correction: Carry the bound identity through finalization. Protect the file through archival or verify the captured file before assigning its terminal suffix. Preserve replacement bytes and single-use removal semantics.
findings.requested_evidence: Replace A's .claimed file with B's bytes during publication, after the successful claim read. Verify that B's bytes never appear in A's .applied archive, the result names the correct horse, and the original repair executes once.
findings.title: Archival can still move different bytes from the claim that was verified
findings.trigger: A held .claimed file is edited or replaced after TryReadClaim returns and before Close renames it in the same poll.

findings.actual: When both counts are unchanged and the target is present, the adapter throws HorseTripRemovalIntegrityException. The new policy treats every such exception as terminal before reaching the still-present retry branch. It writes a failure and archives the request as .uncertain. The existing retry test injects an exception before removal, which takes a different path.
findings.blocking_rationale: A harmless no-op consumes an explicit owner request that mission section 6 requires the service to retain or supersede.
findings.expected: A verified unchanged collection leaves the request eligible for retry, or yields to a newer request through the existing supersession path.
findings.requested_correction: Give verified no-change its own outcome in the production removal classification and route it through the existing return-or-supersede branch.
findings.requested_evidence: Have the native removal return normally with the original feature collection intact. Verify that the request survives, the next successful attempt removes exactly once, and a newer waiting request is preserved.
findings.title: A removal that returns without effect now consumes the request
findings.trigger: Native RemoveFact returns normally with the target and all neighboring features still present.

prior_finding_assessments.rationale: The fixture-intake case is covered. The repository also has an observer-only guarded control that loads a party with runtimeAutomation null. It still selects the player's folder.

A failed final presence read and an explicitly signaled integrity failure now stay terminal. An exception inside native removal or the adapter's earlier verification can still reach Applied solely because the target is absent.

The predicate requires one Bite/Trip component. The candidate gate exercised a stock-GUID feature carrying an additional AddStatBonus and verified preservation in fresh construction and exclusion from saved-horse repair.
The raw digest distinguishes the BOM replacement between polls, and the sharing-violation test preserves the session. The archive rename still operates on an unbound pathname after the digest check.
The return-rename collision now produces Superseded. The recorded real-folder case preserved A's archive and B's request, then applied once to B after both horses loaded.
The contract invoked compiled CopyBody on distinct weapon objects and checked bite/hoof/hoof by reference. The foreign-GUID control used the installed Bite and Trip values and survived the filter.
The candidate log includes nativeProof=false on both the 49-check Trip summary and the 12-of-12 focused summary.

Entry 18 reconciles the enrolled ceilings, and the committed supplemental instruction hashes to the value cited in entry 14. Before this review PR-4 had used 1 of 2 rounds, with 4 child rounds and 11 lifetime rounds spent. The gate ended at 81.66 minutes. All fit the enrolled limits independently of the larger supplemental ceilings.

summary.delivered_behavior: Fresh KMC horses omit the stock Mammoth's single-component TrippingBite grant and retain their bite and two hooves. Existing matches are reported for an explicit owner request. Refusals and supersessions remain frozen through the tested reporting failures. Four saved-horse repair defects block readiness.
